arXiv:2311.04902 (replaced) html
Title: Beyond Size: How Gradients Shape Pruning Decisions in Large Language Models
Rocktim Jyoti Das, Mukul Ranjan
Subjects: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

Large Language Models are pruned using gradients from pretrained models. We present a training-free method and evaluate it across multiple model families.
